## Context

`docs/architecture.md` describes RP-04 as unimplemented. `docs/reuse-surface.md` predicts removal of its diagnostic shadow during S7. RP-04 is closed. Ticket `vibrant-legal-hind`, ADR 0098, and ticket `opal-daffy-mutt` establish the current qualified boundary. `REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW` remains enabled by default and diagnostic only on legacy shadow surfaces.

## Plan

- Describe the implemented `OperationSnapshot` composer.
- Identify each current runtime binding without claiming universal operation control.
- Describe provider authentication carriers.
- Describe the configuration ownership gate.
- Identify the remaining diagnostic-only shadow boundary and its enabled default.
- Replace migration-pending wording that RP-04 completion superseded.
- Preserve ADR 0098 as the historical decision record.
- Leave runtime behavior unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `docs/architecture.md` identifies RP-04 as implemented and describes snapshot composition.
- [x] The documentation identifies the current runtime bindings.
- [x] The documentation describes provider authentication carriers.
- [x] The documentation describes configuration ownership enforcement.
- [x] The remaining diagnostic shadow is described as diagnostic only and enabled by default.
- [x] The documentation does not claim universal operation control.
- [x] ADR 0098 remains unchanged.
- [x] Runtime behavior remains unchanged.
- [x] `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` passes.
- [x] `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_reuse_surface_doc.py tests/unit/test_operation_snapshot.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_operation_snapshot_surfaces.py -q` passes.
- [x] `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` passes.
- [x] `git diff --check` passes.
